== Reward ==

* Electrum-Bladed Wakizashi

== Walkthrough ==
Find "an avenging caitiff" in the underground tunnel beneath Ssynthi's crypt in Castle Mistmoore, near -75, +320.

He will reward you if you bring back the fangs(Butler Syncalls Fang & Maid Issis Fang) of Maid Issis and Butler Syncall to show him that you freed their souls. Maid Issis and the Butler Syncall are located elsewhere in Castle Mistmoore.

Butler: -314.71, -111.77, -188.62

Maid Issis: -339.15, -67.40, -188.62

The teeth are very rare drops (roughly 5% - and these two particular NPC's are usually camped as well). Anyway, if you're lucky enough to obtain the teeth (both of them), you simply give them to Avenging Caitiff. He will give you the EBW. And since Avenging Catliff also drops some nice stuff, he's usually camped 24 / 7 as well (he gets to breathe Norrath air for about 3 seconds before the spells and swords start raining in).

Note: Handing in the fangs will prompt the following text "Mother? Father? May you find peace at last. I shall avenge your suffering! I will grow stronger and set free the souls of the others" and will DESPAWN. He will NOT stick around after the fangs are turned in.

== Dialogue ==
You say, 'Hail, an avenging caitiff'

an avenging caitiff glares at you with fangs bared as he draws an electrum-bladed wakizashi.

You say, 'What about the electrum-bladed wakizashi?'

an avenging caitiff says 'HA! As if a mortal such as yourself is worthy of such a weapon. Leave me to my misson - my purpose in life - the slaying of those who brought me into this existence, then exiled me from this place.'

You say, 'Who is your mother?'

an avenging caitiff says 'My mother was named Issis. She is, to my knowledge, employed as Lord Mistmoore's maid.'

You say, 'Who is your father?'

an avenging caitiff says 'Syncall is my father's name. He serves as Lord Mistmoore's butler.'
